quest.title: Recuperating From a Severe Illness
quest.description: As Anna has been recovering from her illness, she's finally started playing all around the city again. However, Anthony can't seem to find her anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Oh, where has Anna gone this time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can't find Anna again?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Yes. I've searched all over the city for her, but no luck.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Please help me look for her. I'm so tired, I can barely move...

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: It's up to you, then. This girl... If she keeps running around like this when she's almost well, I might fall sick myself.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Hang on... Anna did once say that she's wanted to go to the Cathedral and thank the sisters there.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Perhaps you should check the Cathedral first. You can also check in with Albert...

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: He often, uh, hangs around the Cathedral. Who knows, maybe he's noticed something.

choices.text: Maybe she's gone off to be an adventurer.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: That can't be. It can't be... Can it?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Wow, the sisters really are alert. They almost discovered me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're an agile one...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Wah! How did you know I'd be here? Even the sisters didn't spot me.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Well, since you've found me, I guess I'll head back now.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I just wanted to enjoy the scenery, so don't worry about me.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Did you find Anna?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's on the roof of the Cathedral.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: The Cathedral roof? All those sisters, and not one of them spotted her?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: How did she manage that? Maybe she really does have talent for being an Adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I'll go get her to come down. We really shouldn't be bothering the sisters.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help. Please take these as a token of my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: This kid's really nimble...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, have you seen a girl...

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: You mean Anna? I've seen her, she just ran past me and disappeared down that corner.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Still, the Anna I remember has always been ill, and would sometimes come to the Cathedral to be healed.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: But she doesn't look sick at all. Why, I'd wager that she's got more energy than I do. What happened, I wonder?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Wow, the sisters really are alert. They almost discovered me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're an agile one...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Wah! How did you know I'd be here? Even the sisters didn't spot me.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: You say Albert told you about me? Huh. Who's Albert...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Ah, I remember now. He's that man who always hangs around the Cathedral.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I don't know what he's there for. But I don't think he's a bad person.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Well, since you've found me, I guess I'll head back now.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I just wanted to enjoy the scenery, so don't worry about me.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Have you found Anna?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's on the roof of the Cathedral.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: The Cathedral roof? All those sisters, and not one of them spotted her?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: How did she manage that? Maybe she really does have talent for being an Adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: What? It was thanks to a tip from Albert? Haha, Albert...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: He's something, he is. No matter how many times the sisters warn him, he can always be found loitering around the Cathedral for no good reason.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Well, I'll go get Anna to come down. We shouldn't bother the sisters. Right, and I also need to give Albert my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help. Please take these as a token of my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: If she keeps this up, I'm going to fall sick myself.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: If I became a sister, I'd be able to help lots of people, wouldn't I...

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Anna's recovery is a good thing, in the end. Her brother can breathe easier now.
